plan.hypothesis_to_check: Locate actual generated computation, floating word checks, matrix preflight/allocation and map passes on the three optimization regressors. Deriche causal FSM has one selected F64 input read feeding a compound scalar recurrence; current source-closed-prefix rule requires at least two reads, possibly leaving repeated finite classifications/word conversions. Verify from actual source CFG and sampled machine code before any transformation. Other regressors can reveal shared map/kernel preparation opportunities.
plan.scope_limit: Warm residence includes output drop/reset and differs from official cache-flushed samples. Samples are instruction locations, not exclusive cost/hardware IPC/RSS or speedup forecasts. Retain all failures/observations. No source causality/noise claims for unchanged native functions. No Rust edits during owned jobs. Accepted59 ledger unchanged until new qualified fingerprint passes existing O-only probe/formal gates.
